blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine authorities and Discord have stepped up cooperation to identify malicious actors and address nihilistic violent extremism (NVE) on the platform, less than two weeks after the government briefly blocked the messaging service over online safety concerns. Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) Secretary Henry Aguda led Philippine officials in a virtual “high-level” meeting with Discord representatives on Tuesday evening to discuss how the United States-based fim could help authorities identify and track malicious actors operating on the platform, the agency said in a statement on Wednesday. “They also tackled measures to monitor and address nihilistic violent extremists […]...
